issue.title: [mcp-integration 03/07] Add an MCP client connection factory for stdio, SSE, and HTTP transports (#231)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #330

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-231-mcp-integration-03-07-add-an-mcp-clien-thr_7zw42dhena` to origin.

## Summary

Added the shared MCP client connection factory for issue #231:

- **`connectMcpServer`** (`backend/packages/data/src/mcp/mcpConnectionFactory.ts`) — opens a connection for an `mcpServers` item's `stdio`/`sse`/`http` `connectionConfig`, completes the `initialize` handshake, and returns a connected client with an explicit `close()`. This is the single shared entry point #125 (sync action) and #128 (invoke adapter) are meant to import instead of reimplementing transport handling.
- Credentials are decrypted only at connection time (via the existing `external_credentials` infrastructure) and injected transport-appropriately: stdio through the child process's env, sse/http through a minimal bearer-token `OAuthClientProvider` whose `tokens()` closure is the only place the plaintext ever lives — this avoids the SDK's default behavior of retaining `requestInit`/`serverParams` as plain, JSON-serializable transport properties, which would otherwise leak the credential into the returned client's serializable state.
- Malformed config and credential-decryption failures are rejected before any connection opens; connect/handshake failures map to the same safe `McpConnectionError` shape after releasing whatever was opened.
- No handler is registered for `notifications/tools/list_changed`, satisfying the structural non-reactivity requirement.
- Added minimal MCP contract test servers for all three transports (`testSupport/mcpContractServers`, a new package export subpath) for reuse by #125/#128's own tests.
- New integration test suite (`mcpConnectionFactory.test.ts`, 9 tests) covers per-transport connect/handshake/credential-injection, absence of the credential from the client's serializable state, resource cleanup after `close()` and after failed connects, the `list_changed` non-effect, and safe error mapping.

Verified: full monorepo build (`tsc`, all packages), unit suite (83 tests), integration suite (539 tests, includes the new 9), e2e suite (5 tests), and the dependency-boundary check all pass with no regressions.

1. Bounded `mcpClient.connect(transport)` with a 15s default timeout (overridable) so a server that never answers `initialize` can't hang the factory indefinitely.
2. `resolveCredential` no longer misreports transient DB failures as `credential_decryption_failed` — only genuine decrypt/master-key errors get that classification.
3. Fixed the stdio contract test server's `getHandshakeCount()` to return a real accumulating count instead of a boolean cast to 0/1.

Full test suite (unit: 83 tests, integration: 539 tests, e2e: 5 tests), the dependency-boundary check, and the full monorepo build all pass.

## Summary

This push addresses the round-3 code review finding on PR #330 (CI run `101919493397`):

**Medium correctness finding**: `buildStdioTransport` in `backend/packages/data/src/mcp/mcpConnectionFactory.ts` stripped `StdioClientTransport`'s default environment (`PATH`, `HOME`, etc.) whenever a credential was injected without an explicit `config.env`. The SDK only falls back to `getDefaultEnvironment()`'s safe allowlist when `env` is entirely `undefined` — any other defined object becomes the complete child environment with no merge. Since the credential-injection path always produced a defined object (`{ [credentialEnvVar]: credential }`), any stdio MCP server relying on ambient environment variables would break in that configuration.

**Fix** (commit `c610e8e`): import `getDefaultEnvironment` from the SDK's stdio module, and whenever a defined `env` object is needed at all (`config.env` present and/or credential injection), seed it from `getDefaultEnvironment()` first, then layer `config.env` and the injected credential on top — matching the reviewer's suggested fix.

Verified in this turn:
- `tsc --noEmit` — clean
- Unit tests — 83/83 passed
- Integration tests (includes `mcpConnectionFactory.test.ts`) — 539/539 passed
- E2E tests — 5/5 passed
- Dependency-boundary check — no violations

All three rounds of review findings on this PR are now resolved.

**Medium test-coverage finding**: the `http` describe block in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/mcpConnectionFactory.test.ts` only had one test (credential-injection happy path), while `stdio` and `sse` each also covered connecting without a stored credential and cleanup after a failed connect.

**Fix** (commit `9b7e284`): added two tests to the `http` block, mirroring the equivalent stdio/sse cases:
- `"connects with no credential when none is stored"` — verifies `authProviderOptions(null)` correctly results in no auth header being sent.
- `"leaves no open socket after a failed connect"` — stops the contract server before connecting and asserts `McpConnectionError` with reason `handshake_failed`, exercising `safeCloseTransport` for the Streamable HTTP transport.
